title: Take a virtual tour of the University of Auckland
channel: University of Auckland | Waipapa Taumata Rau
description: Join us for a virtual tour of our campus to see key facilities, programmes and exciting student experiences.

title: Oxford Colleges  –  what exactly are they?
description:
Colleges are small and friendly academic communities which make Oxford a special place to study and live. There are more than 30 of them, big and small, old and young.

Find out more here: https://www.ox.ac.uk/ugcolls

title: University of British Columbia Vancouver
description:
UBC’s Vancouver campus offers you a first-class education at globally-respected, top-40 university, located in one of the most beautiful cities in the world. As well as state-of-the-art facilities for teaching, research, and student accommodation, you’ll discover beautiful beaches, evergreen forests, diverse cuisines, and engaging art and culture – all on campus.

Whether you’re looking to explore new interests or improve at the things you love, UBC is a jumping-off point for adventure. With more than 135 top-tier academic programs and over 300 student-run clubs to choose from, UBC’s Vancouver campus will help you explore your many sides.

Learn more about UBC Vancouver: https://you.ubc.ca/ubc-life/vancouver/

title: One Life-Changing Experience
description:
The University of Oxford offers a unique experience to graduate students, including the opportunity to work with leading academics and with some of the very best libraries, laboratories, museums and collections worldwide. 

Set in the beautiful and historic city of Oxford, the University attracts students from all over the world. 

Made by Angel Sharp Media

title: 2026 台加雙聯學制 格致中學說明會 (字幕)
description:
🎓【格致中學｜LTU OSSD 台加高中雙聯學制說明會】

想在台灣完成高中課程的同時，取得加拿大安大略省高中學分，提前銜接加拿大、美國、英國、澳洲等海外大學嗎？

本次說明會將帶您認識 **LTU OSSD 台加高中雙聯學制**，包含 OSSD 制度特色、課程安排、學分規劃、海外大學申請方式，以及學生如何在台灣高中階段提前建立國際升學優勢。

📌 說明會重點
・什麼是加拿大 OSSD 高中文憑？
・台灣高中生如何同步修讀加拿大課程？
・OSSD 課程與學分如何規劃？
・加拿大、美國、英國、澳洲大學申請方式
・如何依照學生未來目標選擇 Grade 12 科目？
・海外短期交換與國際學習機會
・LTU 在台學習輔導與升學規劃

🌎 **LTU OSSD 台加高中雙聯學制**
讓學生在高中階段增加一條國際升學選擇，依照自己的目標提早規劃未來的大學方向。
